elements.label: Video tile collage reframing around the game-character tile

sfx_review.label: music
sfx_review.note: Continuous harmonic music bed, ~200 ms before the burst; no transient matching the pill reveal.

pattern.description: The video collage re-lays out: the game-character tile grows to become the hero while the other tiles and icon column shift left and shrink; the previous 'Purchase confirmed' pill fades out bottom-left and a new pill grows in on the hero tile, its words 'Mission' then 'accepted' fading in.
pattern.why_premium: One continuous reflow re-targets attention to the use case being named ('video games') without a cut, and the status pill swap reuses the same component so each use case reads as a consistent agent outcome.

build_hint.gsap: tl = gsap.timeline(); tl.to('.collage', {scale: 1.12, x: -60, duration: 0.65, ease: 'power3.out'}).to('.tile-game', {width: '+=180', height: '+=110', duration: 0.65, ease: 'power3.out'}, 0).to('.pill-prev', {autoAlpha: 0, scale: 0.8, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power2.in'}, 0).fromTo('.pill-next', {autoAlpha: 0, scale: 0.6, transformOrigin: 'left center'}, {autoAlpha: 1, scale: 1, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power3.out'}, 0.05).from('.pill-next .word', {autoAlpha: 0, x: 8, stagger: 0.08, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power2.out'}, 0.15). Prefer Flip.from(state) for the tile reflow.
build_hint.remotion: Drive layout with spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 120, mass: 1}}) (no overshoot) interpolated between start and end tile rects; pill: spring scale 0.6->1 with same config, words opacity staggered by 2-3 frames; old pill opacity interpolate over 8 frames.

notes: The outgoing 'Purchase confirmed' pill is not present on the end frame, so it is described in the pattern but not listed as an element. b03/b04 are subtitles baked into the game footage (they move only because the tile scales) and were not listed as separate elements.
